subject: Urgent: Lyra AZ-Gamma checkout errors & routing pressure
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@avalonretail.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Checkout failures and timeouts for Lyra region

Marissa —

We're seeing sustained latency spikes and intermittent 500s from the Lyra (AZ-Gamma) region starting ~08:50 PT. During peak promotional traffic this morning ~09:00–09:30 PT our checkout rate dropped ~37% and several carts failed with 502/503. Attached are a few sample request IDs and timestamps.

This is impacting live orders — we had to open a manual checkout fallback in our web flow which is suboptimal. Can Redwood confirm whether there were changes pushed this morning or if you're seeing any regional capacity saturation? We need immediate mitigation (routing to a healthy region or temporary rate-limiting on experimental features).

Samantha Li
Head of Platform Engineering — Avalon Retail
Samantha.Li@avalonretail.com

Attachments: sample_request_ids.txt (text), console_screenshots.png (image)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@avalonretail.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Apr 2028 09:28:21 -0700
Subject: Re: Checkout failures and timeouts for Lyra region

Hi Samantha — thank you for reporting this and sorry for the disruption. I'm escalating this now to our on-call infra and your account team.

Immediate next steps from our side:
- I have opened a P0 incident (BR-4721) and looped in infra.
- Can you confirm the busiest endpoint(s) you saw errors on (generate, chat reply, or embeddings)?
- We will propose either (a) a rapid geo-steer to eastus2 for a short window or (b) temporary throttling of non-essential background jobs.

Rishi — tagging you for account-level touchpoint and ops coordination. I'm adding the request IDs Samantha shared into the incident.

I'll send an update within 30 minutes once infra triages.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Apr 2028 09:35:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Checkout failures and timeouts for Lyra region

Marissa / Dylan —

We need an operational play and an exec-level brief for Avalon. SLA exposure is real given their live promo.
Dylan — can infra confirm whether this is: kernel-level degradation (KV cache saturation), a regression from a deploy this morning, or external network flapping into AZ-Gamma? Please prioritize logs for 08:45–09:30 PT and surface root cause hypothesis.

Marissa — please prepare a one-page for the CEO and our CRO summarizing customer impact, mitigation (geo-steer plan), and proposed credits if we reach sustained error >0.5% for >30 minutes. I'll own customer comms once we have the triage.

Rishi
Head of Customer Success Operations (acting)
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Apr 2028 10:05:47 -0700
Subject: Re: Checkout failures and timeouts for Lyra region

On Thu, Apr 19, 2028 at 9:35 AM Rishi Malhotra wrote:
> Dylan — can infra confirm whether this is: kernel-level degradation (KV cache saturation), a regression from a deploy this morning, or external network flapping into AZ-Gamma?

Quick summary from infra triage:
- No infra deploys targeted at Lyra were pushed between 07:30–09:00 PT.
- We observed a rapid increase in request fanout at 08:47 PT due to a misrouted batch job from a partner tenant; this caused K/V cache pressure on the serving layer in AZ-Gamma and backpressure to the router.
- Error mix is ~65% 502/503 (backend overload) and ~35% 504 (upstream timeout).
- Mitigation already applied: elevated priority traffic (Avalon token prefixes) has been isolated and given dedicated slots; background partner job is throttled.
- We recommend an immediate short geo-steer to eastus2 for 25 minutes to let caching recover and to avoid customer checkout loss while we rebuild warm KV state.

Attached: error_logs_lyra_0419.tar.gz (excerpt), and a short timeline.

Dylan Brooks
SRE — Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.com

Note: paging the routing team to prepare the steer; ask for approval from execs for cross-region temporary service-level action.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@avalonretail.com>, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Apr 2028 10:40:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Checkout failures and timeouts for Lyra region

Samantha —

Thank you — Dylan's team has identified a partner-originated batch causing K/V pressure in AZ-Gamma. Our recommended mitigations:
1) Immediate geo-steer of Avalon traffic from Lyra to eastus2 for 25 minutes (can be enacted in the next 5–7 minutes).
2) Throttle the partner batch and rebuild warm caches.
3) Post-incident: scope stricter tenant isolation for background jobs and update routing policies to protect token prefixes at risk.

Jonas — I'm requesting exec approval to proceed with the geo-steer (brief to CEO/CRO attached). This will temporarily change traffic routing for Avalon — low risk aside from slightly higher latency for some users.

Samantha — would you like us to (a) initiate the steer now, or (b) run a 5-minute A/B warmup on 5% of traffic before full steer?

Marissa

Attachments: draft_ceo_brief_avalon.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, dylan.brooks@redwood.com

Approved. Proceed with the geo-steer to eastus2 now and run the 5-minute 5% warmup safety check as Marissa suggested. Keep me posted on customer-facing metrics (checkout success rate, error rate, median p95 latency).

Rishi — once the steer completes, send Avalon a short note with the root cause, timeline, what we changed, and a compensation proposal (credit for loss window + review of isolation controls).
